heroSourceLine: Source: Canyons School District 2027–28 K-12 calendar · Revised November 12, 2025
heroSummary: Canyons students in grades 1–12 begin Monday, August 16, 2027, following half-day orientation for sixth- and ninth-graders on August 13. Kindergarten begins August 18. Graduation is May 24, and the last day of school is May 25, 2028. Every instructional Friday is an early-out day, while Brighton High School follows a separate trimester calendar.
calendarNotes: Canyons schedules teachers back August 9–13 and half-day sixth- and ninth-grade orientation August 13 before grades 1–12 begin August 16. Kindergarten begins August 18. The K-12 calendar marks every instructional Friday as early out and prints red A-day and black B-day labels for secondary rotation. September conferences differ by elementary, middle, and high school and lead into a September 23 early-out day, September 24 compensatory day, and September 27 professional day. Fall Recess is October 21–22, Winter Recess is December 20–31, and Spring Break is April 3–7. Brighton shares the August 16 opening and May 25 ending but uses trimester endings November 11 and February 17 plus separate conference, grading, and no-student dates. Emergency closures are recovered through scheduled remote-learning days rather than a fixed make-up date.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2026–27
content: Grades 1–12 begin August 16 and kindergarten August 18, each one day earlier than in 2026–27.
Fall Recess moves from October 15–16 to October 21–22.
The winter conference sequence crosses February and March, with the all-student early-out date on March 2.
Graduation moves one day earlier to May 24, while the last day of school moves two days earlier to May 25.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Canyons School District start in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 begin Monday, August 16, 2027. Sixth- and ninth-graders have half-day orientation on August 13, and kindergarten begins August 18.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Canyons Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break Recess runs Monday, April 3 through Friday, April 7, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Brighton use the K-12 quarter calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Brighton uses a separate trimester calendar with different grading, conference, professional, and compensatory dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Is every Friday an early-out day in Canyons?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Both the K–12 and Brighton calendars say every instructional Friday is an early-out day; the exact dismissal time is school-specific.

calendarFaqs.q: When is graduation for Canyons in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendars list graduation May 24, 2028. Ceremony assignments and times remain school-specific.

calendarFaqs.q: How are emergency closures made up?
calendarFaqs.a: CSD says emergency closure days will be recovered through scheduled remote-learning days rather than a fixed date printed in advance.

sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed the staggered orientation and openings, level-specific conferences, Friday early-out rule, A/B legend, breaks, staff days, district-listed quarter endings, graduation, and May 25 last day from the K-12 PDF.
Reviewed the Brighton PDF separately because its trimester endings, conference dates, grading days, and several professional or compensatory days differ from the district K–12 calendar.
Both PDFs use the November 12, 2025 revision date and state that emergency closures will be made up through scheduled remote-learning days.
We did not find a separate translated 2027–28 calendar in the district resources reviewed.

The one-time ICS file excludes recurring Friday early-out reminders, daily A/B markers, level-specific conferences, quarter endings, graduation, Brighton-only dates, later calendar revisions, and emergency-closure updates.
